notes:
[TXT031-support] Manuscript page 30 continues a), the assertion that F′=G′∪(F\G) is a figure. It first treats supports, then seeks a least member through each point by separating points in |G| from those outside |G|. The displayed brace labels give |G′|=|G| and |F\G|⊃|F|\|G|. Under the stated containment in |F|, these inclusions establish support equality. The main reader also checked why a point of |F| outside |G| must lie in some member of F outside G. This conditional set argument does not prove figurehood.

[TXT031-glyphs] The standalone comparison below donc, comme and the comparison after Comme in b) have a hooked upper stroke over a detached lower bar. Main compared both with the shallower hooked equality in the quantified line and retains =/⊇/≥ explicitly; equality is the first candidate from that same-hand comparison, not from the proof’s desired result. R1/R2 prefer the containment-with-bar shape; R3 prefers equality. The raised mark following G′ has uncertain live-dot versus cancelled-circle state. The final A mark in the first case is bullet/circle, without clear star arms. The extra reversed-membership/superset sign in the small cancelled fragment is restored. None is repaired from the expected mathematics.

[TXT031-wording] The second case literally reads c’est lui plus petit él. de F (et à fortiori de F\G) qui contient x. The dotted i establishes lui; the missing article is not supplied. H’s cf. définition phrase and rearrangement are not in the ink. Both OK checks are retained. The two cancelled introductions before A∈F′ are universal signs, with R1’s Soit/forall dissent recorded.

[TXT031-refinement] Part b replaces raffine by inserted subdivise, then says it suffices to check refinement. Its first attempt is cancelled: l’ens F^A des B∈F tels que A⊂B is an interlinear addition above the base est/et contenu dans sentence; a un plus petit is a separate left addition. C’s extra et duplicates the beginning of the lower phrase. The restatement uses F^A={B∈F | A⊂B} and asks for a least element. For A∈F, A itself is a member of this set and lies below every member by definition; that branch was checked directly. The G′ branch and the subsequent assertion that intersections are unions of strata are carried as the author’s claims, not independently proved. The final line replaces the uncertain R-subscript-F′ saturation wording by fermé dans F′.

The manuscript’s own checking language is Il faut prouver, prouvons A⊂B, OK, OK !, il faut voir seult, and the several c’est évident/c’est vrai assertions. No date, title sheet or total-page statement occurs; manuscript number 30 is present. The small unlabeled hooks at the right edge are drawn without assigning a meaning.
